name: mohaelmrabet/php-llm-router
description: Provider-agnostic LLM client for PHP — a uniform interface over Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, DeepSeek, Ollama, LiteLLM and Kimi, with pluggable routing, retries, caching, circuit breaking, rate limiting, MCP and A2A client drivers, embeddings, and audio transcription.

suggest.ext-redis: Needed for RedisCacheStore/RedisCircuitBreakerStore/RedisRateLimitStore, so cache/breaker/rate-limit state is shared across requests and worker processes instead of just one process.
